SELECT a.question_id, q.question_no, q.question_content, ROUND(AVG(a.score), 2) AS avg_score, q.max_score FROM eval_answer a JOIN eval_record r ON r.id = a.record_id JOIN eval_question q ON q.id = a.question_id WHERE r.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND r.semester_id = #{semesterId} AND r.status = 1 AND q.question_type = 1 GROUP BY a.question_id, q.question_no, q.question_content, q.max_score ORDER BY q.question_no
